Himachal Pradesh Deputy CM Inaugurates Development Projects Worth ₹23 Crore

Himachal Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Mukesh Agnihotri inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for development projects valued at ₹23 crore in Chamba. Separately, Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced that development works worth ₹596 crore would commence in Chamba, with ₹175 crore worth of projects already inaugurated or foundation stones laid.
